ultra rare.name: Shrink
ultra rare.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; its original ATK becomes halved until the end of this turn.

common.name: Toon Dark Magician Girl
common.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 monster, while you control "Toon World". If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. Can attack your opponent directly, unless they control a Toon monster, in which case this card must target a Toon monster for its attacks. Gains 300 ATK for every "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos" in either player's GY.
